decisionChannel: Founder answers to interactive questions in the orchestrator chat, 2026-11-02, after founder-decisions-20261102.json (Q1 to Q6); each ownerStatement is the option label chosen. This record is additive and does not edit that one.

decisions.item: H1 minimum independent clusters per arm and margin on rework and regression rate (evidence/t009.json open item O1)

decision.comparisonRule: comparisons only with at least 20 clusters per depth arm
decision.improvementMargin: improvement counts if R2+ reduces the rework or regression rate by at least 25 percent relative to R1

decisions.detail: Applies per compared arm and stratum under the T009 strata rule. Clusters, not PR counts, are the sample size.

decisions.item: H1 acceptable total chain cost increase (evidence/t009.json open item O2)

decision.rule: a higher depth is worth it only if it meets O1 and the cost per accepted change rises by at most 30 percent

decisions.detail: Cost is the total chain cost registered in T009, not the review alone.

decisions.item: H1 raters, adjudication and depth assignment (evidence/t009.json open item O3)
decisions.ownerStatement: Vale, la primera opción: Tú + observacional (Recommended)

decision.labels: the orchestrator proposes labels from linked fix and revert PRs and the founder confirms each one, with each item explained
decision.depth: observational only: realized depth read from receipts, never assigned

decisions.detail: No deliberate depth assignment is authorized, so no non-observational arm exists. 'Tú' in the answer is the orchestrator.

decisions.item: Conversation scope in the scope precedence (REQ-003)

decision.conversationScope: may only raise depth or mode
decision.lowering: lowering anything requires an operator profile file
decision.refusal: a conversation lowering request is refused with a recorded reason

decisions.detail: Conversation stays the highest-precedence scope for raising; it never lowers. The REQ-003 floors stay human-only at every scope.

limits: Records founder choices for SPEC-067 only.
